rows.text: Timeout | Close stream, retry with exponential backoff

evidence.result: Baseline finding 20261122T235204-5620dd/2 (canonical F-11b5c5ba) re-checked and rejected. The unit sets no deadline of its own on REGISTER, but the exchange is not unbounded: the dialed stream is a muxer channel with an idle timeout (DefaultChanTimeout = 5 min, muxer.nim:12; mplex, yamux and QUIC streams all carry one). When it fires, readLp fails, connection.send records a dial failure (exponential backoff, dial_backoff.nim) and resets the stream in its defer, advertiseToRegistrar returns and the slot is free for the next maintenance pass. Checked with a throwaway test in this session (two real switches over TCP + mplex with a 1 s channel timeout, registrar handler that reads and never answers; file removed afterwards, so there is no command to rerun): the registration task finished 2.2 s after the request and the registrar was in disco.dialFailures; 2 OK, 0 FAILED. The baseline proof used a FaultStream stub with no idle timeout, which is why it saw the task pending forever. What is left is a choice of value the spec does not make: REGISTER waits the muxer's 5 minutes, GET_ADS waits config.timeout (discoverer.nim:167). Not filed.
